items.root_cause: guards.ps1 treats a delegated audit's exit 2 as BOARD scope unless the child affirms a complete cell list, and the delegated audits predate the 2026-09-21 quarantine protocol, so each one still reports its findings in prose only and one bad cell holds the whole board.

root_fix.what: teach each board-scoped delegate to name its cells in the QUARANTINE-CELL protocol, one guard and one fixture at a time, with test-hold-scope's ratchet mark falling with each
root_fix.exact_change: audit-known-wrong: every BLOCKED comparison-board cell printed as 'QUARANTINE-CELL id|store|value' plus the complete line, only when no blocked cell sits on recipe-board.json; audit-pack-basis: each CONFIRMED-PACK-TOTAL cell named as value, no scope affirmed under -Strict with an undecidable finding; TcHoldBoardMark 9 -> 7.

blast_radius.measured_by: guards.ps1 delegate table via test-hold-scope live pass (13 delegates) and the exit-2 paths of the two audits
blast_radius.note: Only the exit-2 path of the two audits: a run that would have held the whole board now names its cells, and guards quarantines them under the existing breaker (more than 2% of priced cells, or 10% of one store's, still holds). A clean run prints nothing new. The BLOCKED-LINK half of known-wrong, a malformed blocklist, a blocked recipe-board cell and pack-basis -Strict still hold the board exactly as before.

proof.must_fire_case: test-known-wrong-scope.ps1 'MUST FIRE  a BLOCKED comparison-board cell exits 2 and is named for guards as salmon / Walmart [value], scope complete' (the founding shape: a ruled-wrong cat food priced as salmon); test-pack-basis-scope.ps1 'MUST FIRE  a CONFIRMED pack total exits 2 and is named for guards as furniture-polish / Sam's Club [value], scope complete' (Sam's Pledge 3 ct., 29 oz.). Both read through Get-TcChildQuarantineScope, the function guards uses.
proof.clean_twin: test-known-wrong-scope 'CLEAN TWIN  a blocked recipe-board cell still exits 2 and affirms no scope, so guards holds the board'; test-pack-basis-scope 'CLEAN TWIN  -Strict over an undecidable finding still exits 2 and affirms no scope, so the board holds'; each suite also has a MUST NOT FIRE clean board.

items.subject: Grocery: beverage class absent on 241 non-drink commodities in five display buckets (residual of 2026-09-18-55b7aa)
evidence: Re-measured 2026-09-25 on comparison-2026-09-23 (seeded 2026-09-25 08:14) with categories.json labels and category-excludes.json at blob 7d70ec60c: the five buckets hold 242 commodities without a beverage apply_id (Baking & Spices 76, Canned & Soup 60, Sauces & Condiments 59, Dairy & Eggs 30, Coffee, Oils & Spreads 17) and 1,152 priced cells. 22 cells match a beverage token and all 22 are the right product: baking-soda x6 (soda), coffee x7 and coffee-creamer x6 (coffee), Aldi 'Nature S Nectar' lemon-juice, lime-juice, orange-juice (nectar). True beverage incursions: 0 of 1,152 (0 of 1,284 on 2026-09-17).

exempt.beverage ('juice|soda|drink|water|tea|coffee|lemonade|punch|cider|kombucha|milk', matched against ids) exempts all six commodity ids behind the 22 hits, so adding beverage to these buckets' apply blocks would fire on 0 of today's 1,152 priced cells.
items.root_cause: audit-food-category scopes a class by display bucket through category-excludes.json's apply blocks, and the shared Dairy/Canned/Sauces/Baking/Coffee blocks carry no beverage class, so a drink crowning a non-drink commodity sold by the fluid ounce (oils, vinegars, sauces) would be seen by nothing: kind_mismatch_crown only catches a fluid-ounce drink on a weight or each commodity.
items.freshness: measured 2026-09-25 on comparison-2026-09-23 as seeded into this worktree
items.premise_verified: true: the five buckets still carry no beverage class (apply blocks read at blob 7d70ec60c); the class has still never occurred there (0 of 1,152).
items.deviation: Bounced: the fix is an edit to grocery/category-excludes.json, which this lane may not touch. The measurement the item said was missing is done and rides with it. Also noticed for the money lane: exempt.beverage is an unanchored substring over ids, so any id containing 'tea', 'milk' or 'water' (steak, watermelon, condensed-milk) is exempt from the beverage class wherever it applies.
items.resolution_note: Bounced to the money lane (owner of category-excludes.json) with its routing measurement: adding beverage to the five buckets' apply blocks would fire on 0 of 1,152 priced cells today, every one of the 22 token hits being exempt by id; the queue id stays open for that lane.
items.leaves_open: the whole class (a drink on a fluid-ounce non-drink commodity in five buckets), 0 occurrences, pending the money lane's category-excludes.json change
